Engineers possess exceptional ingenuity and are known for their eccentric and marvelous inventions.

SKILLS

EMERGENCY ITEM · SL max 1

Once per conflict scene, while in Crisis: perform an additional action on your turn, which must be the Inventory action.

GADGETS · SL max 5

Choose a gadget type — alchemy, infusions or magitech — and gain its basic benefits. Each further level buys a new type's basics, or upgrades one you have to advanced, then superior.

POTION RAIN · SL max 2

Your potions that restore one creature's HP/MP may affect up to (SL) additional creatures, at half effect for everyone.

SECRET FORMULA · SL max 5

Your restorative magispheres and potions restore (SL × 5) more HP/MP; your elemental shards, magispheres and potions deal (SL) extra damage.

VISIONARY · SL max 5

Projects you work on auto-pay up to (SL × 100) zenit of material costs and gain (SL) extra progress per day. Makes a Project-holder better — never grants Project access.

DISMANTLE · SL max 5

Destroy an item worth 100z+ that you own (never an IP-crafted one) to regain (value ÷ 100) IP, +1 IP if it cost at most (SL × 200)z. In conflict this rides an Inventory action.

BREAKTHROUGHS AND MISHAPS · SL max 4

When progressing a Project, opt for +2 progress and roll d8: at or under (SL), the invention gains a one-use bonus function; 7–8, the Project stalls until a condition is met. Does nothing without the Projects pool pick.

QA: Engineer

  • Source: Fabula Ultima: Core Rulebook, pp. 227–230 (printed as TINKERER)
  • Rename: Tinkerer → Engineer (CLASSREF-core-fifteen.md, documented rename, applied silently)
  • Heroics: Numerous via compendium (see HEROICS-compiled.md)
